title: Service status
text: All Demo Bank services are fully operational. There is no plan to suspend or stop services.

title: Customer funds
text: Customer deposits are safe. Customers do not need to withdraw funds because of any rumour.

title: Scheduled maintenance
text: Demo Bank will carry out scheduled system maintenance on Sunday from 1am to 4am. Card and transfer services may be briefly unavailable during that window only.

title: Fees
text: Demo Bank has not introduced any new fee on transfers or withdrawals. All charges are as listed on the official tariff page.

title: Account security
text: Demo Bank staff will never ask customers for their PIN, password or OTP by phone, SMS or social media.
